book.name: Ibulu
book.title: Ŋwa wù ba gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Ba'ibulu le

content: Kune ki ba lêe nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ wu Nyo le

Fi mo fi nyu lɛ ŋka wù Nyo gɛ̀ gɛlɛ lɛ bamii lé bo gê bo lêe nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ we le wu baaŋ gɛh wu lɛme fo. Noo, besabɛŋ mo be yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ sege ba jiŋɛ, ba yɛ̂ŋ muh mu bɛŋ le baaŋ a kojɛ gɛ ki wu lêe wu le gɛ.
Njɛme nɛ, nje Saaka wù joŋe wunɛ le wu to wa fɛ besabɛŋ le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no wu gɛ̀ to fɛ bo le. Geenɛ, saaka wuyu wù bo gɛ̀ yu, wu gɛ baaŋ bo fi gɛ, nje wu gɛ̀ to fɛ bo le bo faŋ ki bo bɛ̂ɛŋ wu le.
Fɛ besabɛŋ ba bɛɛŋ wu le, besabɛŋ taŋlo bee ge be lêe nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ wuyu le. Bamii bamu baa le Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Shɛ́ŋ gɛ̀ toonyɛ mɛ, nleh lo lɛ,
‘Gɛ bo nyume bo yu bo tô bo lêe lo nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ waŋ le gɛ.’”

content: Nyo gɛ̀ jɛme nɛ, fi nyume gɛ lɛ kijusɛ ki nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ gɛ̀ fuge lo gɛ kɛge no Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ woŋ.
Besabɛŋ kee lɛ ba le ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le fɛ kijusɛ kimu le kune juu chi aju a bvusooshwi a yinɛ je le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo gɛ̀ bee wu lɛŋ lɛme che chichii,
doo yisɛ aju bvusooshwi wu fufɛ shɛ́ŋ.”

content: Lɛ doo nyu kijusɛ kì bo be jɛme wa kɛɛ le, wu ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ bo nyume bo yû bo lêe lo nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ waŋ le gɛ.”
Fi baaŋ fi lɛme gɛh lɛ bamii bamu le bo ge bo lêe nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ wuyu le. Bamii ba gɛ̀ yu saaka wù joŋe wunɛ gɛ̀ baaŋ lee gɛ nje bo gɛ̀ yu bo faŋ ki bo gê no Nyo jɛme.
Noo, Nyo mo wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛ juu chimi chì wu tɛŋe lɛ, “Abɛŋ.” No wu gɛ̀ gɛlɛ noo, wu mo wu jɛme fiɛɛ jwe wu Nfoŋ Dabi le a biluŋ fe wa wesee, no besabɛŋ be yu wa lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ bɛŋ yu lo Nyo jɛme bɛŋ le abɛŋ,

content: Nɛ le lɛ kijusɛ ki Joshwa gɛ̀ jo bamii wu gɛɛŋ wu lee bɛ bo fo gɛ̀ bee wa kijusɛ ki nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ kiyu le, tu gɛ Nyo baaŋ wu ka wu jɛme kune juu chimi lɛ le chi nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ gɛ.
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ juu chi nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ baaŋ fwe fɛ bamii ba Nyo le, njɛ chì Nyo gɛ̀ fufɛ shɛ́ŋ chiɛɛ.
Fi nyu lɛ, nɛ muh lese yi nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ wunɛ le, tu mwɛdɛ fufɛ wa shɛ́ŋ yi lɛme che le chichii, yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Nyo gɛ̀ fufɛ shɛ́ŋ yi che lɛme le.
Noo, besabɛŋ mône chuule ki bee lêe nfufɛ shɛ́ŋ wunɛ le, wu lɛ keefɛ muh mu gê wu gwê lɛ baji kikwɛɛ kì tɛmɛ wu gɛ, njɛ bamii ba fweele baa gɛ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ jɛ yi Nyo kɛme kinche, yi lɛne. Yi koode yi fede mbiɛle wù ba le ba foŋ bimbe bichii. Yi to yi lese yi gɛɛne yi bude fɛ kinche bɛ kiyo ki muh taashi fo, yi lese tɛ yi gɛɛne yi bude fɛ bin'yuŋ bɛ asaa taashi fo. Yi to yi bwaashi baŋkwajɛ mo mwɛɛ mù le a fitele fì muh le.
Gɛ fiɛɛ nyu lo yu fi Nyo fɛ fì taŋlo fi nyilɛ a wu jii gɛ. Mwɛɛ munchii to mu gweenyi a wu jii mu dunyi nɛ waaŋ. Le wu wù besabɛŋ kɛme ki be gê be tânyɛ jwe a wu fwe.
Jiso le kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ kì baaŋ

Noo, no besabɛŋ be jɛme wa lɛ besabɛŋ kɛme kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ kì baaŋ, kì le Jiso wù Mwa Nyo, wu gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ wa wu chiɛɛ kibvulɛ wu gɛɛŋ fɛwe, besabɛŋ mo be jîji mbɛmɛ wu besabɛŋ to be sɛŋe bamii le chuule.

Gɛ kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ kesa besabɛŋ kinɛ nyu muh wù taŋlo wu maŋe kiwɛɛyɛ kesa besabɛŋ wu lɛ wu kôode yii fɛ besabɛŋ le gɛ. Wu le muh mmoŋ gɛ̀ to wa tɛ fɛ wu le a jé le jé le no wu too fɛ besabɛŋ le, geenɛ wu gɛ̀ baaŋ ge gɛ kimbefɛ gɛ.

Noo, besabɛŋ mo be kɛ̂ɛŋse bee too besabɛŋ maŋe gɛ mbebe kala wu Nyo le fɛ wu to wu dunyi fitele fì joŋe, wu lɛ wu kôo yii fɛ besabɛŋ le, doo nyume kife kì fiɛɛ yage besabɛŋ wu dûnyɛ fitele fì joŋe fɛ besabɛŋ le wu fîh bee.
